title.zh: 经世系的演化：不加前提的会计恒等式；只有被支持的形成留下后代，在界内传递的所需在界内被选择，活动设定后来的选择
title.en: Evolution on descent: an accounting identity with no premise; only supported formations leave descendants, what is transmitted within a bound was selected within it, and activity sets later selection

claim.zh: 以一类关系项读：一个关系项跨一步从一个形成而来（Flow.DescendsAt、Flow.Descends），当这个形成参与该步、在该步给予它，而它跨该步开始作为条件而在。不加前提：对任意有限的亲代家族、每个亲代的有限后代列表，以及在亲代与后代上读出的任意量，后代的总量加上传递所降低的，等于每个亲代的量按其后代数计数，加上传递所升高的（price）。这是 Price 方程（Price 1970）的计数形式，一个会计恒等式：它把后代的总量分为亲代的量按其后代加权，以及每个后代相对其亲代的变化。加权总量不是真正的选择项：每个亲代都有 k 个后代时，它是亲代总量的 k 倍（selected_uniform）；一个亲代、一个不变的后代时，它就是亲代的量（unselected）。真正的选择项，即后代数与量的协方差，不在这里陈述。只有活跃形成给予（Acting）且活动需要支持（Dependent）时：一个关系项跨一步从之而来的形成在该步被支持（Flow.DescendsAt.supported）；在一步不被支持的形成不在该步留下后代（Flow.unsupported_childless），从不被支持的形成没有后代（Flow.never_supported_childless）；读于每个亲代都依存的条件上的所需，亲代所需按后代数加权的总量至多是该条件的水平按后代数计数（Flow.selected_le），所以后代任意量的总量加上从亲代所需降低的，至多是这样计数的水平加上升高的（Flow.selection_within）。流在 δ 之内传递对条件 c 的依存（Flow.TransmitsWithin：在开始作为条件而在之步依存于 c 的后代，只从在给予之步依存于 c 的形成而来，且所需至多多 δ；作为前提给出）时，传递的在 δ 之内被选择：后代的所需至多是该条件在给予之步的水平加 δ（Flow.transmitted_supported）；δ 为零时所需在那里被满足，δ 为一时后代的所需可以在给予之步与每一步都超过条件的水平（Slack.slack）。在平衡的流中，后代的所需加上自较早一步以来从该条件取用的，至多是该条件那时的水平加上其后给予它的，再加 δ（Flow.transmitted_within）：其间形成的取用与给予进入后来能传递的。见证：一个以所需二依存于池的亲代从池取用，并给予两个后代（Drawdown）；承继其所需的那个从它开始作为条件而在之步起不被支持，因为亲代的取用降低了池；所需较少的那个被支持、活跃，并转而取用；传递、变异、选择与活动对选择的反馈在同一展开中。没有 Dependent 时不然：超出支持而活跃的形成，传递高于其给予之步水平的所需（Unchecked）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Read with one kind of relatum, a relatum descends from a formation across a step when the formation takes part in the step and gives to it, and it comes to stand across the step (Flow.DescendsAt, Flow.Descends). With no premise: over any finite family of parents, each with a finite list of offspring, and any amounts read of parents and offspring, the offspring's total with what transmission lowered is each parent's amount counted once for every offspring, with what transmission raised (price). This is the counting form of Price's equation (Price 1970), an accounting identity: it divides the offspring's total into the parents' amounts weighted by their offspring and the change from each parent to its offspring. The weighted total is not the selection term proper: where every parent has k offspring it is k times the parents' total (selected_uniform), and with one parent and one unchanged offspring it is the parent's amount (unselected). The selection term proper, the covariance of offspring number and amount, is not stated here. Where only active formations give (Acting) and activity needs support (Dependent), a formation that a relatum descends from across a step is supported at that step (Flow.DescendsAt.supported); a formation unsupported at a step leaves no descendant across it (Flow.unsupported_childless), and one never supported leaves none (Flow.never_supported_childless); read of needs on a condition every parent depends on, the parents' needs weighted by their offspring are at most the condition's level counted once for every offspring (Flow.selected_le), so the offspring's total of any amount, with what transmission lowered from the parents' needs, is at most the level so counted, with what transmission raised (Flow.selection_within). Where the flow transmits a dependence on a condition c within δ (Flow.TransmitsWithin: a descendant depending on c at its first standing step descends only from formations depending on c at the giving step, and needs it at most δ more; supplied as a premise), what is transmitted was selected within δ: a descendant's need is at most the condition's level at the giving step, plus δ (Flow.transmitted_supported); with δ zero the need was met there, and with δ one a descendant's need can exceed its condition's level at the giving step and at every step (Slack.slack). In a balanced flow, a descendant's need with everything taken from the condition since an earlier step is at most the condition's level then, with everything given to it since, plus δ (Flow.transmitted_within): what formations take and give between enters what can be transmitted later. Witness: a parent depending on a pool at need two takes from it and gives to two descendants (Drawdown); the one inheriting its need is unsupported from its first standing step on, since the parent's taking lowered the pool, while the one needing less is supported, active and takes in turn; transmission, variation, selection and the feedback of activity on selection occur in one unfolding. Without Dependent it need not hold: a formation active beyond its support transmits a need above the level at the step it gives (Unchecked). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: price 不加前提：任意有限的亲代列表、每个亲代的有限后代列表（可以重叠或重复）与任意自然数的量；“降低”与“升高”是截断差（excess），两者之一为零。
hypotheses.en: price has no premise: any finite list of parents, any finite list of offspring for each (which may overlap or repeat) and any natural-number amounts; ‘lowered’ and ‘raised’ are truncated differences (excess), of which one is zero.

hypotheses.zh: 选择：只有活跃形成给予（Acting），活动需要支持（Dependent）；selected_le 与 selection_within 另要求每对亲代与后代在同一步上有世系，且每个亲代在该步依存于该条件。
hypotheses.en: Selection: only active formations give (Acting), and activity needs support (Dependent); selected_le and selection_within also require each parent–offspring pair to be related by descent across the same step, and each parent to depend on the condition at that step.

hypotheses.zh: 传递：TransmitsWithin 是由应用给出的前提，正如重构在演化之论中是前提；transmitted_within 另加平衡（Balances）。
hypotheses.en: Transmission: TransmitsWithin is a premise supplied by the application, as reconstruction is in the theory of evolution; transmitted_within also uses balance (Balances).

correspondence.zh: 计划 P21 要求在脊柱上给出经世系的传递、变异与选择，以及差别经由传递进入后续活动、改变后续选择的条件。演化之论的核心候选说：组织的差异通过实际传递参与后续活动，并改变变异、发育、共同生活与下一轮选择的条件。本结果给出这一候选在脊柱上最小的形式内容：选择是支持（水平满足所需）对谁能给予的约束；传递是后代对亲代依存的承接，由应用给出；变异是所需的差别；活动经平衡改变条件的水平，从而改变后来能传递的（transmitted_within、Drawdown）。price 是会计恒等式：两份既有研究笔记已手推其协方差形式并说明这一点（direction-frontier 的 math-note；GENERATED-SELECTION-RECURRENCE-INTEGRATION 引 Frank 2012），本结果不改进 Price 方程，只在纯核心中用计数形式检查它；除以亲代数并改写为协方差的形式需要有理数，这里不陈述。实质内容在选择与传递的定理中：适应度没有定义，后代数只作为 price 中的权重，支持只作为给予的条件。演化之论的独立纲领（结构复制、重构、发育、组织规则的继承，例如 inherited-structural-copying 与 organizational-rule-inheritance）保持原范围；这里没有证明与它们的对应。对其完成要求 2（恢复既有演化解释）只贡献 Price 方程的计数形式；突变、漂变、迁移与种群动力学不在其中。“世系”“传递”“选择”“变异”在这里的读法是 AI 的表述，名称由 Ren 定。
correspondence.en: Plan P21 asks for transmission, variation and selection through descent on the spine, with differences entering later activity through transmission and changing the conditions of later selection. The theory of evolution's central candidate says that differences in organizations enter subsequent activity through actual transmission and alter the conditions of variation, development, shared living and later selection. This result gives that candidate its minimal formal content on the spine: selection is the constraint that support, a level meeting a need, places on who can give; transmission is descendants taking up their parents' dependences, supplied by the application; variation is the difference in needs; and activity changes a condition's level through balance, and with it what can be transmitted later (transmitted_within, Drawdown). price is an accounting identity: two existing research notes derive its covariance form by hand and say so (the direction-frontier math-note; GENERATED-SELECTION-RECURRENCE-INTEGRATION, crediting Frank 2012). This result does not improve Price's equation; it checks it in counting form in the pure core. Dividing by the number of parents and rewriting as a covariance needs rationals and is not stated here. The substantive content is in the selection and transmission theorems: fitness is not defined, the number of offspring enters only as the weight in price, and support only as the condition of giving. The theory of evolution's independent programme (structural copying, reconstruction, development and the inheritance of organizational rules, for example inherited-structural-copying and organizational-rule-inheritance) keeps its scope; no correspondence to it is proved here. To its completion requirement 2, the recovery of established evolutionary explanations, this contributes only Price's equation in counting form; mutation, drift, movement and population dynamics are not covered. The readings of ‘descent’, ‘transmission’, ‘selection’ and ‘variation’ here are the AI's formulations, and names are Ren's.

detail.zh: 复用 P18 引入、P18b 改正的世系关系（给予的形成须参与该步）；定义移入 Becoming.Evolution（DescendsAt、Descends），在估值中的读法留在 Becoming.Descent。
detail.en: Reuses the descent relation introduced in P18 and corrected in P18b (the formation giving must take part in the step); its definition moves to Becoming.Evolution (DescendsAt, Descends), and its readings in valuation stay in Becoming.Descent.

output.zh: 一个关系项从参与某步、在该步给予它的形成而来，它跨该步开始作为条件而在。
output.en: A relatum descends from a formation that takes part in a step and gives to it, as it comes to stand across the step.

input.zh: 世系的每一对上，亲代在给予之步活跃且被支持。
input.en: On every pair related by descent, the parent is active and supported at the giving step.

detail.zh: 复用截断差 excess 与 excess_balance；price 的每一项由它们逐对给出。
detail.en: Reuses the truncated difference excess and excess_balance; each term of price is given pairwise by them.

output.zh: a 加上 b 超出 a 的，等于 b 加上 a 超出 b 的。
output.en: a with the excess of b over a is b with the excess of a over b.

input.zh: 每个后代的量加上降低的，等于亲代的量加上升高的；对亲代与后代求和即 price。
input.en: Each offspring's amount with what was lowered is its parent's with what was raised; summed over parents and offspring this is price.

detail.zh: 复用流、平衡、Acting、total 的引理与 Balances.accumulates。
detail.en: Reuses flows, balance, Acting, the total lemmas and Balances.accumulates.

output.zh: 平衡的流中，一个条件之后的水平加上其间的取用，等于之前的水平加上其间的给予。
output.en: In a balanced flow, a condition's later level with the uptake between is its earlier level with the replenishment between.

input.zh: 后代的所需加上其间的取用，至多是较早的水平加上其间的给予，再加 δ。
input.en: A descendant's need with the uptake between is at most the earlier level with the replenishment between, plus δ.

detail.zh: 复用开始作为条件而在（ComesToStand）：世系跟着水平的上升走。
detail.en: Reuses coming to stand (ComesToStand): descent follows the rise of a level.

output.zh: 一个关系项跨一步开始作为条件而在。
output.en: A relatum comes to stand across a step.

input.zh: 世系的第三个合取项；TransmitsWithin 读的是后代开始作为条件而在之步的依存。
input.en: The third conjunct of descent; TransmitsWithin reads the descendant's dependence at its first standing step.

detail.zh: 完成计划第 9 节下的 P21：演化的最小形式内容在脊柱上。
detail.en: Completes P21 under the plan's section 9: the minimal formal content of evolution on the spine.

detail.zh: 演化之论独立纲领中的结构复制；TransmitsWithin 在这里是前提，那里由实际的复制机制给出；对应未证明。
detail.en: Structural copying in the theory of evolution's independent programme; TransmitsWithin is a premise here, given there by an actual copying mechanism; no correspondence is proved.

detail.zh: 社会组织中规则差别的形成与继承；同样保持原范围。
detail.en: The formation and inheritance of rule differences in social organizations; it likewise keeps its scope.

detail.zh: Unchecked 中的亲代超出支持而活跃，即有储备；储备使高于水平的所需得以传递。
detail.en: The parent in Unchecked is active beyond its support, that is, with a reserve; a reserve lets a need above the level be transmitted.

detail.zh: 没有 Dependent：超出支持而活跃的亲代以所需二依存于水平为一的池，给予一个承继其依存与所需的后代；传递的所需高于给予之步的水平（Unchecked.unchecked）。
detail.en: Without Dependent: a parent active beyond its support depends at need two on a pool at level one and gives to a descendant inheriting its dependence and need; the need transmitted exceeds the level at the giving step (Unchecked.unchecked).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词；适应度没有定义，不说哪种所需更好；传递（TransmitsWithin）是前提，脊柱不推出后代承接亲代的依存；price 是会计恒等式，只以加法计数形式与自然数的量陈述，不含协方差形式；选择只读作支持对给予的约束，不含繁殖率、突变、漂变、迁移或种群动力学；只对离散步的读法陈述；与演化之论既有机制的对应未证明；名称由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate; fitness is not defined, and no need is said to be better; transmission (TransmitsWithin) is a premise, and the spine does not derive that descendants take up their parents' dependences; price is an accounting identity, stated only in additive counting form with natural-number amounts and without the covariance form; selection is read only as the constraint of support on giving, without reproductive rates, mutation, drift, movement or population dynamics; stated for the reading across discrete steps; no correspondence to the theory of evolution's existing mechanisms is proved; names are Ren's.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261009T192237.890720Z）：新模块 Becoming.Evolution 的 25 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 27 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 1153 项定理／1857 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261009T192558.793391Z 通过。作者反审见整合文档 §29；第九次独立审查（BECOMING-P18B-P23-REVIEW.md）接受其数学，所提更正在整合文档 §34 处理。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 29 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T192237.890720Z): the 25 theorems of the new module Becoming.Evolution all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 27 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1153 theorems/1857 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261009T192558.793391Z passed. The author's counterreview is in §29 of the integration note; the ninth independent review (BECOMING-P18B-P23-REVIEW.md) accepts its mathematics, and its corrections are handled in §34 of the integration note. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 29 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: TransmitsWithin 能否由一类读法中的给予与依存的形成推出，而不作为前提；有理数量与协方差形式；后代数如何受给予的量约束（繁殖的读法）；多步的选择与传递的累积；与结构复制、重构及组织规则继承的对应定理（外围）；名称（Ren）。
next_delta.en: Whether TransmitsWithin can be derived from how giving and dependence form in the one-kind reading, rather than supplied; rational amounts and the covariance form; how the number of offspring is bounded by the amounts given (a reading of reproduction); the accumulation of selection and transmission over many steps; correspondence theorems to structural copying, reconstruction and the inheritance of organizational rules (periphery); names (Ren).
